description: Work on cutting-edge AI safety research focused on alignment and interpretability of large language models. Collaborate with world-class researchers to make AI systems more reliable and beneficial.
Build scalable machine learning infrastructure for AWS services. Work with distributed systems, deep learning frameworks, and cloud architecture.
Conduct fundamental research in reinforcement learning and develop novel algorithms for complex decision-making problems.
Lead product strategy for AI-powered features in Microsoft 365. Define roadmap and work cross-functionally with engineering and design teams.
Analyze large-scale datasets to improve model performance and understand user interactions with AI systems.
Design next-generation AI accelerators and GPUs. Work on architecture, verification, and performance optimization.
Build and scale infrastructure for Meta's AI research and production systems. Work with PyTorch, distributed training, and data pipelines.
Develop and deploy ML models for Siri's natural language understanding and generation capabilities.
Work on computer vision algorithms for Tesla's autonomous driving system. Train and deploy models on custom AI chips.
Build open-source ML tools and libraries. Contribute to Transformers, Datasets, and other popular frameworks.
